title: Data Architect / Data Lead
description:
Data & AIOnsiteFull-timeID: REQ-43637

N2P Systems

Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 10+ years ₹12L - ₹15L Posted 1 month ago

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

This is a critical position, and we are looking to close the role at the earliest.

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect / Data Lead with 15+ years of overall IT experience and strong hands-on experience in data architecture, data engineering, and enterprise data solutions.

The ideal candidate should have progressed through hands-on data engineering/technical roles into a Data Lead or Data Architect position, with the ability to provide both strategic architectural direction and practical technical leadership.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are not purely architecture-focused, but have strong hands-on technical experience as a Data Lead/Data Engineering Lead and have grown into an architecture role.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and implement enterprise-level data architecture and data strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performance data platforms and solutions.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across data engineering, data integration, data modeling, and data management.
* Design and review data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern data platforms.
* Lead technical discussions with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and senior leadership.
* Establish standards for data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, security, and performance.
* Evaluate existing data platforms and recommend modernization opportunities.
* Guide development teams on architecture, technology selection, coding standards, and best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex data and performance issues and provide technical solutions.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.
* Mentor senior developers, data engineers, and technical leads.
* Participate in architecture reviews, solution design, estimation, and technical documentation.
* Required Technical Experience
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in data technologies.
* Proven experience working as a Data Architect, Data Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent senior data role.
* Strong hands-on experience in data architecture and data engineering.
* Expertise in data modeling, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse and data lake architectures.
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT and data integration frameworks.
* Strong SQL and database development experience.
* Experience with one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with modern data technologies such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, or equivalent platforms is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of distributed data processing and large-scale data systems.
* Experience designing APIs/data integration solutions and working with enterprise applications.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, security, metadata management, and master data management.
* Leadership & Communication
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into technical data architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to lead architecture discussions and influence technical decisions.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and senior management.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently while leading cross-functional technical teams.
* Must be willing to work on-site from Coimbatore.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in enterprise-scale data transformation or modernization programs.
* Experience leading large-scale data migration initiatives.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Relevant cloud/data certifications are an advantage.
* Ideal Candidate
* 15+ years | Data Architecture | Hands-on Data Lead Experience | Cloud & Modern Data Platforms | Strong Technical Leadership | Coimbatore On-site
* Immediate requirement – early closure preferred. Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will be given preference.

### **Target Tech Stack**

Data ArchitectureData EngineeringData ModelingData Warehouse and Data Lake ArchitecturesETL/ELT and Data IntegrationSQL and Database DevelopmentAWSAzureGCPModern Data TechnologiesBachelor's or Master's degree

title: Specialist - Cloud & Infra Management
description:
**Role description**

Job Title: Specialist - Cloud & Infra Management  
Location: Coimbatore  
Experience: 5-7 years

This is a critical and urgent opportunity for a Specialist - Cloud & Infra Management to join our team in Coimbatore. We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive professional to ensure the robust and secure operation of our hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a strong focus on network and contact center systems.

Job Description:  
1. Design, implement, and manage complex network infrastructure solutions, leveraging expertise in Cisco DC/Branches Routers & Switches and Juniper DC/Branches Routers and Switches.  
2. Administer and optimize NICE Contact Center environments, ensuring seamless operation, high availability, and exceptional user experience.  
3. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for network and infrastructure components, including architecture diagrams, IP schemes, and configuration standards.  
4. Proactively monitor system performance, conduct capacity planning, and perform advanced troubleshooting to identify and resolve issues swiftly across cloud and on-premises environments.  
5. Lead incident response efforts for critical infrastructure outages, ensuring rapid diagnosis, resolution, and post-incident analysis to prevent recurrence.  
6. Implement and enforce stringent security policies, network segmentation, and access controls to protect sensitive data and systems.  
7. Facilitate the secure integration of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) with on-premises data centers, managing connectivity, data flows, and hybrid solutions.  
8. Manage vendor relationships, coordinate hardware/software lifecycles, and oversee patching and upgrade initiatives for network and contact center systems.  
9. Participate actively in change management processes, scheduled maintenance windows, and on-call rotations to support 24/7 operational demands.  
10. Ensure strict adherence to operational audit requirements, maintain meticulous change records, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills and Qualifications:  
Mandatory Skills:  

* Cisco DC/Branches Routers & Switches
* Juniper DC/Branches Routers and Switches
* NICE Contact Center

Required Qualifications:  

* 5-7 years of hands-on experience in network and infrastructure management.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in enterprise-scale environments with formal ITSM, security, audit, and change management processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, urgent environment.
* Experience with hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and secure integration patterns.

About the Role:  
This role demands a proactive and urgent approach to managing complex cloud and on-premises infrastructure. You will be instrumental in maintaining the stability and security of our critical systems, responding swiftly to incidents, and driving forward key infrastructure initiatives.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  
Apply now to make an immediate impact!

  
**Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Cisco DC/Branches Routers & Switches, Juniper DC/Branches Routers and Switches, NICE Contact Center

 **About LTM**  
LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We bring human insights and intelligent systems together to help clients create greater value at the intersection of technology and domain expertise. Our capabilities span integrated operations, transformation, and business AI — enabling new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value. Together with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries and our global network of partners, LTM — a Larsen & Toubro company — owns business outcomes for our clients, helping them not just outperform the market, but to Outcreate it. title: Pricing & CPQ - Analyst 2
description:
**Job Title \- Pricing \& CPQ \- Analyst \- ACS SONG**

**Management Level: Level 11 \- Analyst**

**Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad**

**Must have skills: PROS Smart Price Optimization**

**Good to have skills: Pricing Tools**

**Experience: 2\-3 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


Results\-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid\-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote\-to\-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross\-functional teams—sales, finance, product, and IT—to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
* Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
* Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client’s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
* Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
* Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis \& Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
* Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best\-in\-class KPIs
* Work as an integral part of the client’s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
* You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing \& CPQ area.
* The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

  

**Professional and Technical Skills:**

* 2\-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications \& High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
* Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization \& Management (POM) \& Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
* Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Knowledge of other Pricing \& CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

**Additional Information**

* Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
* PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management  

PROS Smart Configure Price Quote
